summary:
Phase 7 (video player + growth + booking) frontend verification. Backend sanity: GET /api/public/certificates/TESTPDF1/pdf -> 200 application/pdf (2025 bytes, valid %PDF-1.3 magic); GET /api/files/private/file_1f2efd7ac05a Range bytes=0-1023 -> 206 Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/991017 accept-ranges: bytes. Both backend sanity checks green. Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844):
1) CLIENT LESSON VIDEO — /portal/lesson/les_ed60baecc057 loads with a real <video> element inside the 16:9 stage, signed src (/api/files/private/{id}?t=<media token>) resolved OK; native browser controls render; playback errors with codec-4 (headless Chromium can't decode H.264) so the friendly overlay 'This video can't be played here...' is shown AS EXPECTED — the overlay text is inside the card (no overflow, w=390 within the card padding); all 5 speed pills (0.75x / 1x / 1.25x / 1.5x / 2x) are present, tapping 1.5x switches its background to brandTertiary (rgb 42,38,28) with champagne-gold border (rgb 229,208,161) and gold text — meanwhile the '1x' pill went back to surfaceSecondary. Time readout '0:00' renders. 'Mark as complete' toggles to 'Completed — undo' and back.
2) PUBLIC BOOKING /book/jcg-test — HERO: brand-neutral calendar icon + 'JCGFIT' kicker + headline 'Book with Coach JCG' + intro + UTC pill. SESSION TYPE chips (Intro call · 30m / Coaching session · 60m) both selectable, chip becomes gold when active. 21-day horizontal day strip renders and scrolls; selecting day+1 reloads AVAILABLE TIMES (28 slots). Picking a slot reveals the form card; NAME + EMAIL fields ARE shown when unauthenticated (plus notes multiline). Submitting 'Request this time' -> 'Request sent' card visible (booking-done testID) with 'jcgfit will confirm your Coaching session on 9/2/2026, 7:00:00 AM.' text. Reloading same day confirms the just-booked slot disappeared from the list (27 remaining, without the taken slot).
3) COACH BOOKING WORKSPACE /studio/booking — the URL box shows https://gemini-mobile-app-12.preview.emergentagent.com/book/jcg-test with copy + share buttons; booking-enabled-switch renders (RN Switch on web doesn't expose aria-checked so we couldn't read the boolean, but toggling changes the label text 'Live — anyone with the link can request a time'). Session type list shows the two seeded types. 'Add' opens the New Session Type sheet -> TEST_p7 Quick chat / 15 min / Zoom test was added and then removed successfully. Mon–Sun day toggles change bg colour from brandTertiary to surfaceSecondary; adding a day materialises a new availability row with start/end fields. Confirming the pending TEST_p7 booking created above moved it into UPCOMING with a CONFIRMED pill (upcoming-bk_418267125887 shows 'TEST Guest 340516 · CONFIRMED · Coaching session · 9/2/2026, 7:00:00 AM · Cancel'). Rules save via save-rules-btn returns 200. There were also 8 residual PENDING requests left over from the pytest suite (Lead Larry / Nobody / Prospect Pat / etc.) — expected artifacts of test_phase7_booking.
4) CLIENT PORTAL SESSIONS /portal — 'SESSIONS' section appears with 'Book a session' row (portal-book-session) subtitled 'Pick a time from your coach's open slots' and one 'portal-booking-bk_a4954e1a8f41' row (Pytest call · 9/1/2026 5:00:00 PM · PENDING pill). Tapping the row navigates to /book/jcg-test and the NAME + EMAIL fields are hidden (only notes visible) — signed-in prefill.
5) CHALLENGES — with no existing challenges the client saw 'No challenges yet'; created TEST_p7 Streak 7 (14 days, target 7) as coach via /studio/challenges + button, then re-logged as client: client sees LIVE pill, 'Workouts logged · target 7 · 0 joined · ends 9/15/2026' meta, tapping 'Join challenge' switches to 'Leave' (join-{id} testID text toggled). Leaderboard sheet opens, shows own row (Jeremy C Gillespie, rank 1, score 0) with gold name text inside the sheet + TOP PROGRESS TO TARGET section. Leaving flips label back. + button only visible for coach role (correctly hidden for client).
6) CERTIFICATES /studio/certificates — TWO certs render (cert_test1 code TESTPDF1 for 'Rowing Strength Program' + cert_78ab863d4936 code 44219413 that was AUTO-ISSUED when I marked the 1-lesson 'Video Demo Course' complete during flow 1). The branded card shows CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION, client name (Jeremy C Gillespie), course title in gold, lesson count, coach, date, cert code (No. TESTPDF1 / No. 44219413), a hair-line rule, Download PDF and Share buttons. Tapping Download PDF opens a popup with the certificate URL. Tapping Share does NOT crash (no red screen). Note: copy grammar bug — '1 lessons · coached by ...' should be '1 lesson'. Not blocking. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

Carried over from iteration_5/6 — root cause is a wrapping View/Button prop instead of style.pointerEvents. Not blocking. test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_booking.py (existing suite — not re-run per E1's instruction)
action_items: SEED DATA DRIFT (main issue found): the /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_booking.py suite PUTs the coach's booking settings with slug 'pytest-booking' + a single 'Pytest call' session type + 8 residual pending requests, which permanently clobbers the seeded 'jcg-test' slug because booking_settings is one-row-per-coach. I re-seeded jcg-test with Intro call (30m) + Coaching session (60m) + availability 06:00–20:00 Mon–Sun so the manual/user flow works, but the pytest suite should either (a) register a throwaway coach and run all its assertions against that coach, or (b) snapshot + restore jcgfit's booking_settings in a fixture teardown. Also the residual PENDING rows from Lead Larry / Nobody / Prospect Pat should be cleared by the tests themselves.
OPTIONAL: fix the '1 lessons' pluralisation in certificates.tsx line 69 — `${c.lesson_count} lesson${c.lesson_count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`.
OPTIONAL: chase the pointerEvents-as-prop warning (login screen + booking page) — should be style.pointerEvents. Carried over from prior iterations.
NICE-TO-HAVE: on /studio/booking, expose the Switch's on/off state via a data-attr or aria-checked so integration tests can assert persistence programmatically without depending on label text.
critical_code_review_comments: app/book/[slug].tsx — line 73-75: prefill effect writes user.name/user.email into local state but the visible input is conditionally hidden (`!user`). Because submit() sends name/email from state, the request works when the user is authenticated. However this means an authenticated client with a blank .name (rare) would send an empty name silently. Consider falling back to user.email as name if user.name is empty. Minor.

app/book/[slug].tsx — after a successful booking, submit() sets `done` state and shows the confirmation card, but the ScrollView above is unmounted, so if the coach's page reloads the slots list is only refreshed on the NEXT visit. That's fine for the confirmation UX but means the browser back-button lands on a fresh state (empty slot picker) — expected.

app/studio/booking.tsx — save({}) merges an empty patch just to persist local edits (slug/headline/intro/tz etc.). This works, but any partial save wipes local errors first. Consider passing only the changed fields for less foot-gun potential.

app/studio/booking.tsx — tapping the enabled Switch calls save({enabled:v}) which immediately PUTs. If the network fails, load() is called and the switch snaps back — this is correct behaviour. Verified no crash.
app/studio/challenges.tsx — the Sheet closes with escape/back but there's no explicit 'close' testID on it (only onClose). Not blocking.
app/studio/certificates.tsx — pluralisation copy bug at line 69 (see UI bugs above).

app/portal/lesson/[id].tsx — the DIRECT_MEDIA regex only matches URL suffixes .mp4/.mov/.m4v/.webm/.m3u8. External URLs with query strings but no extension (e.g. YouTube shorts) will correctly fall back to 'lesson-video-btn'. Verified with lesson.video_file_id path in this run.

components/player/LessonVideo.tsx — useEvent hook (from 'expo') on 'statusChange' + 'timeUpdate' is the modern expo-video API — good. The player retains `timeUpdateEventInterval = 2` (2s) to throttle position saves, and storage.setItem writes 0 once the user is within 5s of the end. Solid resume UX.
components/player/LessonVideo.tsx — the error overlay opacity fills the whole card so tapping speed controls underneath is not affected (controls sit outside the stage). Good.
routes_booking (per credentials file) — pytest suite is a hard tenant collision on the same coach. Recommend refactor per action item #1.

rca_of_issue: Seed data drift: /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_booking.py at line 45 hard-codes `slug = 'pytest-booking'` and PUTs it into jcgfit's ONE booking_settings row (booking is one-doc-per-coach in MongoDB). Consequence: after any pytest run, /book/jcg-test 404s and the coach's session types collapse to a single 'Pytest call'. Reproduction: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_booking.py` then curl `/api/public/book/jcg-test` -> 404, and curl `/api/studio/booking/settings` -> slug='pytest-booking'. Mitigation applied here: PUT /api/studio/booking/settings with the canonical jcg-test payload documented above. Long-term fix: (i) create a throwaway coach in the pytest module scope and run all booking assertions against it, or (ii) snapshot settings on setup and restore in teardown, or (iii) allow multiple booking pages per coach so the test can target a distinct slug without clobbering the seed.
